## Problem and result

Describe the user-visible problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Include a minimal reproduction
or screenshots when behavior is visual. Explain any unverified environment.

## Review notes

Identify contract/profile changes, dependency changes and their purpose, fixture
provenance, or material limitations. Mention substantive AI assistance when it
helps the reviewer understand how the patch was verified.

- [ ] I reviewed the full diff and can explain the change.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; acceptance thresholds remain in profiles.
- [ ] No secrets, proprietary assets or personal paths were added.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material under the project license.
